paragraphs: The Judges of the Exile: Karna (see his entry). In Bava Batra 51, beginning of side a; 70, beginning of side a and side b; 100, end of side a; 107b, Rashbam writes: “The Judges of the Exile are Shmuel and Karna, in Sanhedrin chapter 1.” End of quotation. He is mistaken, for in Sanhedrin chapter 1, 17b, Karna alone is “the Judges of the Exile,” and Shmuel is “our masters in Babylonia.” The newer Talmud editions did not correct it.
